content.title: 1 Consumer Stock with Competitive Advantages and 2 We Ignore
content.summary: Regarded as defensive investments, consumer staples stocks are generally safe bets in choppy markets. On the other hand, they usually underperform during bull runs, and this paradigm has rung true over the past six months as the sector’s -7.5% decline paled in comparison to the S&P 500’s 20% gain.

content.title: Kellanova (K): Margin Gains Reinforce Quality Narrative Despite Slower Growth Versus Market
content.summary: Kellanova (K) just reported net profit margins of 10.6%, a notable increase from last year’s 6.7%, and delivered standout earnings growth of 54.8% over the past year. Looking ahead, the company expects 6.5% annual EPS growth and a 2.5% uptick in revenue per year, both trailing US market averages. However, with profitability and margins in focus, the overall results paint a picture of improved financial health.
